vocab.definition: a mixture of a metal with one or more other elements.
free electrons that carry charge and heat.
can be bent and shaped — layers slide.
allows electricity/heat to pass through easily.

misconceptions.wrong: Alloys are softer than pure metals.
misconceptions.right: Alloys are usually harder than pure metals.

infoPanels.title: METALLIC STRUCTURE
infoPanels.secondaryContent: Different sized atoms in an alloy stop the layers sliding, making it harder.
